newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU calls for Serbia poll results to be validated.
newsitem.headline: EU calls for Serbia poll results to be validated.

text.p: The European Union, expressing full support for Serbia's Zajedno (Together) opposition coalition, on Monday demanded the Belgrade authorities recognise opposition victories in municipal elections last November.

Dutch Foreign Minister Hans Van Mierlo told reporters the EU's 15 foreign ministers expressed "total determination" that the report of the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) be implemented by President Slobodan Milosevic.
This verified the opposition's claim to have won Belgrade 13 other towns where the ruling Socialists annulled elections in November claiming "irregularities".

The opposition bloc has staged nine weeks of mass demonstrations to reinstate the results while western governments have told Milosevic to forget about economic reconstruction aid unless his government admits the poll losses.
Van Mierlo said the EU would keep in close contact with the opposition and said there was no question of any change of position to accept a "a partial implementation by Milosevic".
